rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a person who hosts a broadcast programme.

example.english: The presenter was pretty funny tonight.
example.traditional: 今晚個主持人講嘢幾好笑。
example.jyutping: gam1 maan1 go3 zyu2 ci4 jan4 gong2 je5 gei2 hou2 siu3

rows.note: Use this for the master of ceremonies at an event rather than for a broadcast host.

example.english: The wedding banquet presenter said they would get everyone in the mood.
example.traditional: 聽日個婚宴司儀話會帶動氣氛。
example.jyutping: ting1 jat6 go3 fan1 jin3 si1 ji4 waa6 wui5 daai3 dung6 hei3 fan1

rows.note: Use this for the handheld remote used to advance slides during a presentation.

example.english: Remember to bring the presenter when you give the presentation.
example.traditional: 做簡報嗰陣記得帶埋簡報筆。
example.jyutping: zou6 gaan2 bou3 go2 zan6 gei3 dak1 daai2 maai4 gaan2 bou3 bat1
